item: a retired resume watcher leaves at once, and no test may leave one running
summary: _resume_watch slept RESUME_POLL_S (30 s) before it looked at its generation, so a watcher retired by cancel_pending_resume stayed alive up to 30 s and tests/test_resume_watcher_thread_start_failure.py (no watcher alive) failed on CI shard 2 of PRs #1754, #1764 and #1757 whenever an earlier test of the shard had handed off to a default-poll watcher. The wait is now an Event (_RESUME_WAKE) that every cancel or newer watcher sets, so a retired watcher leaves in the moment it is retired (wake=None keeps the old sleep). An autouse fixture in tests/conftest.py cancels the pending resume after every test, joins any oo-resume-watch for up to 2 s and fails the test that left one alive, by name. Release-notes line (R319): none for users, the change is in how a scheduler thread waits and in the test suite. Limit: the single leaking test was not named; the shard-2 run that would name it did not finish on the build machine.
